name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
_note: Fact base to 30-Sep-2026. Rs crore unless stated (AR figures are in Rs million in the source and converted here). Consolidated unless marked standalone.

q1call._dateNote: Webinar held 21-Jul-2026; transcript filed on BSE shortly after (exact filing date not visible to us).

ar26._dateNote: Accounts approved 30-Apr-2026; the AR was filed before the AGM (Screener document list). Exact filing date not visible to us; used only for FY26 figures known since 30-Apr-2026.

guidance._note: Management interview with CNBC-TV18, reported by Angel One.

profile.what: India's largest online B2B marketplace. Suppliers (mostly MSME manufacturers, traders and distributors) list products free; buyers post requirements free. IndiaMART earns subscription fees from paying suppliers for better visibility and buy leads (Silver monthly/annual, Gold, Platinum tiers), collected in advance and recognised over the subscription. Busy Infotech (100%) sells desktop/cloud accounting and GST software to MSMEs.
profile.scale: 8.8 Mn supplier storefronts, 218K paying suppliers, ~41 Mn active buyers, 26 Mn unique business enquiries a quarter, 132 Mn live product listings, ARPU Rs69K (Q1FY27 deck). Platinum and Gold are ~50% of paying suppliers and >75% of revenue; the top ~10% of customers make ~50% of revenue (Q4FY26 call). Four industries (plant & machinery, industrial and electrical equipment) are ~30% of paying suppliers.
profile.market: ~1.6 crore GST-registered businesses in India; ~50 lakh GST-identified sellers registered on IndiaMART, 2.2 lakh paying (Q4FY26 call). Management: about 50% of the serviceable market is already on the free tier.
profile._employeesSrc: MOSL 21-Jul-2026 (Q1FY27 headcount; 6,222 at Mar-26 per AR FY26)

shares._note: Crore shares: promoter Dinesh Agarwal's 1,68,27,523 shares = 28.01% (AR FY26) -> 6.008 crore. 1:1 bonus in Q1FY24; buyback in FY24.

rows: Treasury: fair value, interest and sale income on mutual funds, ETFs, bonds, debentures, InvITs

otherIncomeBuild._oneOffNote: Fair-value gains on strategic investments and the gain on selling an associate stake are not treasury income and are not forecast. FY23-FY24 interest, write-back and miscellaneous lines (Rs5.9 cr and Rs4.0 cr in total) are not split in our AR FY24 extract.

call: Silver monthly churn ~7%, Silver annual ~4%; Platinum churn well below 1% a month, Gold 1-1.5% (Q4FY26 call); 'nothing has changed' (Q1FY27).
Management will not chase gross additions until renewal behaviour (product-market fit) improves: acquiring low-end customers 'will make the CAC go higher and the LTV go lower'.
Unique business enquiries 26-27 Mn, flattish; ~4-5% of the YoY decline from OTP buyer verification (bot filtering), the rest unexplained between own changes, traffic moving to LLMs and the war.
Board approved IndiaMART Finance Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary to facilitate short-term transaction finance with partner lenders; no large lending from its own balance sheet.
Busy: billing +10% (Q1FY26 had ~Rs10 cr of one-off win-backs; ~30% normalised); revenue +47%; target 27-30% CAGR for the next couple of years; Busy Magic relaunch.
Other income Rs107 cr 'primarily due to mark-to-market gains on our treasury portfolio' (CFO).
q1fy27.src: Q1FY27 deck and webinar (21-Jul-2026); MOSL 21-Jul-2026 (associates, headcount)

guidance: No guidance on net supplier additions 'until we have multiple quarters of continual success'
Busy: ~27-30% revenue CAGR over the next couple of years; licence growth target 15-20%
history: Founded by Dinesh Agarwal and Brijesh Agrawal as an online B2B directory (AR FY24: 'Established in 1996').
IPO and listing on NSE/BSE (offer for sale; price series from 5-Jul-2019).
QIP: ~Rs1,070 cr raised (AR FY24), lifting cash and treasury from Rs931 cr to Rs2,365 cr (Q1FY27 deck).

Strategic investments of Rs395 cr and Rs570 cr: Vyapar, Mobisy (Bizom), Truckhall (SuperProcure), Fleetx, IB MonotaRO and others; Busy Infotech acquired (100%, Rs509 cr invested) and Livekeeping (Rs96 cr). Goodwill of Rs454 cr from FY23.
1:1 bonus issue; buyback (tender route) in FY24: Rs681 cr returned to shareholders that year including dividends.
Gain of Rs29.2 cr on sale of an associate stake; FY25 dividend Rs50 (Rs30 final + Rs20 special).
Silver-tier price increase; gross additions slow; paying suppliers 222K (Sep-25) to 218K (Jun-26).
FY26 dividend Rs60 (Rs30 final + Rs30 special), paid Jul-2026; ~Rs1,650 cr returned to shareholders since FY21.
Board approves IndiaMART Finance Ltd (transaction-finance facilitation).
